source_text: Unusquisque se ipsum consideret quid fecerit confusione dignum; Deus cordis et renis occulta considerat. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Let each consider himself what he has done worthy of confusion; God considers the hidden things of heart and kidneys. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Let each examine himself >> Bible:1 Corinthians 11:28]]: word, deed, thought that deserve blush before him who [[searches heart and kidneys >> Bible:Psalm 7:9]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
